name: Sheet Consolidator
description: Merges spreadsheet sheets into one table. Never overwrites your files.
about: Point it at a folder of spreadsheets and it works out what each sheet holds, proposes how to merge them, and asks you to confirm. It matches records across sheets, flags duplicates for your approval, and writes the result to a new file or sheet without touching your originals.
features: Profile every sheet in your folder
Match and dedupe records with your approval
Write results to a new file, never overwrite
examplePrompt: Consolidate the sheets in this folder into one table, matching leads by phone number and then email.
